patch_list: Bypasses mock location and emulator detection in GajiHub by neutralizing Location.isFromMockProvider() flags in React Native location bridges, forcing Build.TYPE user checks to true, and disabling emulator detection in RNDeviceInfo.
Disables OTA JavaScript bundle updates, version queries, Revopush differential patching, update dialogs, and hard-locks runtime bundle loading to the APK's local assets in GajiHub.

Disables third-party telemetry, crash reporting, and tracking services in GajiHub. Suppresses Sentry native SDK initialization, OneSignal analytics and device tracking, neutralizes root detection telemetry, and disables Sentry/Firebase bac…
Adds Pause/Resume and Force Submit buttons plus pushed location count to the live tracking notification.
Replaces com.google.android.geo.API_KEY in AndroidManifest.xml with a user-supplied Google Maps API key so map tiles load on non-root re-signed APKs.
